notes: Cost centres 1: grid for names / project data; new cost centres are created with the button (legacy tree insert: next child of the chosen parent or a typed code checked against the structure), with parent status and grants; delete rules (APP_RULES3_GL, see processes/ACCSTCD.md)

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or COST_CODE in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers m2, ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0')))

params.name: PARENT
